tasks.short: Verify staff credentials against the actual role requirements

steps.what: Collect staff credentials and identify the current requirements for the actual spa role
inputs: Role requirements supplied by the responsible owner
outputs: Identified evidence and requirements with missing items marked

steps.what: Stage exact credential identifiers, dates and requirement matches from structured source fields
inputs: Explicit credential type and date rules
outputs: Staged comparison with source links and unmatched fields

steps.what: Verify authenticity, resolve identity or requirement exceptions and decide whether the evidence meets requirements
inputs: Issuing body's actual verification channel, defined as OTHER
outputs: Human credential assessment with unresolved cases held open

steps.what: Complete and check the exact verification record against the evidence and decision
Save the checked credential verification record

tasks.design: Configure {HCM} to stage exact credential fields and compare them with owner-maintained requirements. The manager still verifies authenticity and exceptions, checks the complete record and saves it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Evidence and requirements may sit in different records, requiring repeated comparison.
tasks.enabler_now: Native credential fields and explicit expiry or type rules can support a staged comparison.
tasks.still_hard: A matching name or date does not establish authenticity or permission to perform a service.
tasks.human_edge: Resolve ambiguous evidence and determine whether further verification is needed.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: personnel systems can hold credential fields and apply explicit date and type checks; issuing-body verification remains a separate human check.

assumptions: Conditional workflow where the manager currently compares structured credential fields manually; no measured baseline is claimed.
Staff supply certificates and requirement owners supply current rules; manager collection, identity checking and missing-field handling are included in s1 and s3. Unstructured evidence stays manual.
Use native HCM configuration first. Existing automatic checks earn no new saving.
The save takes approximately no time today; its 1% bookkeeping allocation is fully retained and earns no saving.
Illustrative effort weights sum to 100 independently of prompt time-share priors. Gross saving 25, upkeep 3, net 22 per 100 task hours.
unknowns: Actual evidence formats and available issuer verification channels
research_questions: Which credential fields are currently compared manually and which already have native checks?

already_counted.description: Source collection, authenticity and exception decisions and complete final-record verification

incremental.description: Maintain requirement mappings and investigate failed field staging

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete record checked in s4; any edit requires another check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Unmeasured scenario: 25 gross less 3 incremental upkeep; no saving for authentication, judgement or saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Establish the spa budget and financial goals

steps.what: Collect and reconcile actual booking, sales, payroll and expense inputs for the budget period
inputs: Booking and retail records from the spa management system, defined as OPS_SYSTEM
Ledger and payroll records produced by their owners
outputs: Checked source extracts, period definitions and explicit assumptions

steps.what: Import checked extracts and calculate exact revenue, cost and scenario totals using explicit formulas
inputs: Checked extracts and definitions from s1
outputs: Reconciled budget tables and formula exceptions

steps.what: Set feasible financial goals and resolve staffing, service capacity, pricing and cost tradeoffs
outputs: Selected budget and goals with manager-authored rationale

steps.what: Complete and check the final budget version, assumptions and financial goals
Save the checked budget and goals

tasks.design: Use {SPREADSHEET} imports and formulas for budget tables from checked spa, payroll and ledger extracts. The manager authors assumptions and goals and checks the complete final version before saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual transfer and repeated calculation obscure the assumptions that need attention.
tasks.enabler_now: Native imports, tables and formulas can reproduce explicit calculations.
tasks.still_hard: Demand, staff capacity and service quality tradeoffs require local judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Choose achievable goals and explain the operational consequences.

ambition.what: Compare another explicitly authored capacity or demand scenario within the same planning session.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: spreadsheet imports and formulas can assemble exact budget scenarios from structured source records.

assumptions: Conditional manual-transfer budget episode, not an observed baseline or automatic forecasting claim.

Operational, finance and payroll owners produce source records in their normal work; manager extract collection, reconciliation and assumption capture are in s1 and s3. Missing or inconsistent fields remain manual.
Native features first; any existing import and formula automation is already baseline and earns no additional saving.

This establishes the manager's budget version; any required higher-authority approval must inspect that final version before spending authorization, with its labour added. Saving does not authorize expenditure.
All 100 illustrative effort points are focal. Gross 30 less upkeep 3 gives net 27; the negligible same-system save is fully retained.
unknowns: Actual source exports and delegated budget authority
research_questions: Which transfer and calculation steps are still manual in the current budgeting process?

already_counted.description: Source reconciliation, actual goal setting and final budget checking

incremental.description: Maintain import mappings and scenario formulas

approvals.approved_version: Complete budget and goals checked in s4; edits invalidate this check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Illustrative 30 gross calculation and transfer saving minus 3 upkeep; goal-setting and final review remain human.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Recruit, interview and hire spa employees

steps.what: Define the vacancy and check actual role requirements and hiring authority
inputs: Actual staffing need and owner-supplied employment terms

steps.what: Complete and check the exact vacancy posting and application instructions
Publish the checked vacancy
Read applications, interview candidates and assess their suitability against the actual spa role
outputs: Manager's interview observations and hiring assessment

steps.what: Select the candidate, capture the actual hiring decision and complete and check the exact offer and matching hiring record
inputs: Permitted terms and confirmed candidate details
outputs: Final checked offer and hiring record

steps.what: Send the checked offer to the selected candidate
Save the checked hiring decision and offer status
inputs: Final checked hiring record from s5
outputs: Saved decision with offer pending acceptance

tasks.design: Use native {ATS} templates for existing vacancy and offer fields, with no candidate scoring. The manager assesses candidates and checks each complete posting, offer and record before the separate publication, send and save actions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated entry of vacancy and offer details consumes some preparation time.
tasks.enabler_now: Native templates can reuse confirmed fields without generating hiring judgements.
tasks.still_hard: Interviews, suitability and employment terms remain human decisions.
tasks.human_edge: Assess evidence fairly and make accountable hiring choices.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: applicant-tracking templates can reuse confirmed vacancy and offer fields while managers retain hiring decisions.

assumptions: One representative recruitment episode with actual manager-owned posting, interviews and offer preparation; no measured task mix is claimed.

Candidate applications are produced by candidates; manager reading, observation capture, decision and final checks are retained. Scheduling and rejection messages are not silently automated and must be added if part of the actual episode.
Native templates first. Only field entry is reduced in s2 and s5, not final checks, candidate evaluation or terms decisions; existing templates earn no new saving.

Assumes actual delegated authority to publish and offer these terms. If another owner must approve, that owner must review the completed final version before the respective action and their labour must be included.
Offer remains pending acceptance; no payroll activation or implied accepted contract. Credential verification is separate task 17614 and must not be counted twice.
Gross saving 1.8 plus 1.8 equals 3.6; incremental upkeep 1 gives net 2.6 per 100 illustrative task hours. All sends and saves are retained.
unknowns: Actual hiring authority and current template coverage
research_questions: How much confirmed-field re-entry remains after existing ATS features?

already_counted.description: Interview assessment and retained vacancy, decision, offer and record preparation/checking

incremental.description: Maintain vacancy and offer template fields

approvals.approved_version: Exact posting checked in s2; edits require recheck
Exact complete offer checked in s5; edits require recheck
Exact hiring record checked in s5, with actual send status only

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Conditional field-entry saving 3.6 less upkeep 1; no automated selection or assumed interview saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop service and retail goals and coach spa staff

steps.what: Review actual service and retail results, staff context and customer needs
inputs: Service and retail records produced in the spa management system, defined as OPS_SYSTEM

steps.what: Develop realistic staff service or retail goals and discuss progress and practical improvements with staff
outputs: Manager and staff understanding of goals and next actions

steps.what: Capture the actual agreed goal record and check its complete wording and values
inputs: Actual goals and actions from s2

steps.what: Save the checked staff goal record

tasks.design: Configure an existing results view in {OPS_SYSTEM} and fixed goal fields in {TALENT}. The manager develops goals with staff, captures the actual discussion and checks the final record before saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the relevant existing results and repeating record fields takes some effort.
tasks.enabler_now: Native views and forms can expose already-recorded results and reuse confirmed identifiers.
tasks.still_hard: Fair goals, service quality and useful coaching depend on the person and situation.
tasks.human_edge: Listen, set realistic expectations and help staff change their practice.

ambition.what: Support current goal setting and guidance.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native operational views and goal forms can reduce lookup and repeated field entry without replacing staff coaching.

assumptions: Conditional episode where an actual goal record already accompanies coaching; do not add a record to every informal conversation or extrapolate this mix without observation.

Operational staff produce service and retail source entries; manager retrieval, context checking and actual discussion capture remain in s1-s3. No free cleaned performance feed or inferred employee traits.
Native features first. Existing results views and forms are baseline, not new saving. No automated targets or employment decisions.
Same-system save is negligible and fully retained. All 100 illustrative effort points are focal; gross 2 plus 1.4 equals 3.4, less upkeep 1 gives net 2.4.
unknowns: Actual goal-record practice and native view availability
research_questions: Is lookup or repeated field entry material in observed goal-setting sessions?

already_counted.description: Results interpretation and actual goal capture and final checking

incremental.description: Maintain result view and goal form fields

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete goal record checked in s3; any edit requires recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Illustrative lookup and field-entry saving 3.4 less 1 upkeep; coaching and goal decisions retained.
